definitions.explanation: Moving or operating at a fast rate.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}で{事故|じこ}があった。
examples.english: There was an accident on the expressway.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}バスで{大阪|おおさか}まで{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to Osaka by express bus.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}インターネット{回線|かいせん}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I'm using a high-speed internet connection.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}を{降|お}りてから、{一般|いっぱん}{道|どう}で20{分|ぷん}かかる。{渋滞|じゅうたい}がなければ、もっと{早|はや}く{着|つ}く。
examples.english: After getting off the expressway, it takes 20 minutes on regular roads. If there's no traffic, we'll arrive faster.

notes:
{高速|こうそく} means high speed or expressway.

AS 'HIGH SPEED':
- {高速|こうそく}{回線|かいせん} (high-speed connection)
- {高速|こうそく}{処理|しょり} (high-speed processing)
- {高速|こうそく}{列車|れっしゃ} (high-speed train)

AS 'EXPRESSWAY':
- {高速|こうそく}({道路|どうろ}) (expressway)
- {高速|こうそく}に{乗|の}る (to get on the expressway)
- {高速|こうそく}を{降|お}りる (to get off the expressway)
- {高速|こうそく}バス (express bus)

CONTRAST:
- {高速|こうそく} (high speed) ↔ {低速|ていそく} (low speed)
- {高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ} (expressway) ↔ {一般|いっぱん}{道|どう} (regular road)
